adventureObjects.mapStateRule: One animation per state in the own namespace, matching the five fortification and hall stages.

puzzle.rule: A 48-piece native puzzle map, each piece an own artwork in the Zaun namespace.

assetBinding.rule: Each of the 36 states needs a full-canvas layer, an area mask and a border mask in the own namespace; the masks define the click geometry and are derived from the painted layer.
assetBinding.status: 146 bounded town recipes prepared with the actual existing Zaun converter; technical execution does not grant art/native/rights approval.

canvas.currentState: Selected painted-depth-20261024-v2: enlarged near worker-yard/tavern framing, smaller distant civic/foundry landmarks, staggered dry terrace groups. Existing painted V3 background retained; no new camera projection or painting claimed. Native graphical acceptance remains pending.
canvas.layerModel: Every structure is authored as a full-canvas layer with an area mask and a border mask. Masks, not hand-tuned rectangles, define the clickable geometry, so a painted layer can be replaced without editing configuration.
canvas.reference: the native Heroes III town canvas used by the Castle faction

derivation: All36 selected building states preserve their21 painted master files and exact crop selectors. Whole-source uniform scaling/placement and alpha-derived masks/icons follow the finite prepaint plan; the separate genuinely painted background must match the actual full foundations and doors.

layoutPolicy.composition: One dark chempunk Zaun iron-and-glass neighborhood, organic streets/alleys/industrial platforms and inhabited edges; toxic low light, local vivid chemical green, deep violet shadow and rust-brown masonry. Much larger physically grand rear institutions; readable front façades. Neon chemical green is localized glass/lamps, with purple Shimmer/cloth and brown rust. No universal near/far size ratio, plot-grid or three horizontal terrace bands.
layoutPolicy.functionalBoundary: Preserve twenty independent sites and thirty-six states, layers ordered by depth and exposed alpha-derived click areas. Natural partial occlusion is allowed; no building may be completely hidden or unselectable.
layoutPolicy.siteGeometry: Exact twenty composition rectangles/state render limits and dry support are merged into sites; full-canvas origins remain0,0; alpha-derived masks supply click geometry. No equal-scale grid or unintended solid-body overlap.
layoutPolicy.supersedes: The user-rejected sparse rocky town/foreground-to-background universal scaling quota; native hallSlots are a separate consumer.

siege.shooterRule: The tier three chemical construct is the siege shooter of the town, so the siege screen shows a construct on the walls. It is a machine, not a person, and it fires its own pressurised shot.

siteGroupingNote: Twenty independent sites cover all 36 authored building states: three chain sites (the four hall states, the three fortification states and the four mage guild states), seven dwelling sites with two states each, six service sites (tavern, market, forge, shimmer factory, wharf with its moored barge, and the grail hall) and four special sites. The Fighting Pit is its own independent site: it is a fourth special building that pays a daily wage and is not a construction stage of the tier seven dwelling. State arithmetic: 4 + 3 + 4 + 14 + 7 + 4 = 36 states over 20 sites.
